source_state: Working tree implementing bounded Zarr submatrices and weighted operations.
command: compute bench --reason 'verified submatrix products and weighted operations versus native views' -- cargo bench --locked --bench submatrix --features ndarray,sprs,zarrs -- --sample-size 10 --warm-up-time 0.1 --measurement-time 0.2
timing_statistic: Criterion bootstrap mean with 95% confidence intervals, in nanoseconds.
notes: Short smoke measurements in one exclusive compute window with all baselines and candidates. Timings are illustrative.
